# Brand Assets

Official ɳSelf brand assets for use in integrations, articles, and community content.

## Asset Location

| Location | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `.github/docs/brand/` | Canonical assets for contributors and press |
| `.claude/docs/brand/` | AI reference copy (same content) |

## Available Assets

### App Icons

PNG masters at 512×512px with derived sizes:

| Size | Use Case |
|------|---------|
| 512×512 | Master / App Store |
| 256×256 | Desktop icon |
| 128×128 | Toolbar / favicon source |
| 64×64 | Small UI |
| 32×32 | Favicon |
| 16×16 | Browser tab |

### Icon Variants (7)

| Variant | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Default | Indigo background, white ɳ mark |
| Dark | Dark (#0F0F1A) background |
| Light | White background |
| Monochrome (dark) | Black icon, no background |
| Monochrome (light) | White icon, no background |
| Indigo fill | Full indigo with white mark |
| Outline | Outline style, transparent background |

### Horizontal Logos

Full wordmark with ɳSelf text, available in dark and light variants.

### File Formats

- **PNG**, raster masters (preferred for most uses)
- **SVG**, vector source files (for print and large-format use)

## Download

Browse and download assets from the [`.github/docs/brand/`](../blob/main/.github/docs/brand/) directory.

## Usage Guidelines

See [[Logo-Usage]] for clearspace rules, approved backgrounds, and prohibited uses.
